tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas in both themes, and the theme-color meta value. Also fills the hero corner block, its concave masks and the split-hero seam so they read as cut out of the glass.

tokens.name: bg-warm
tokens.usage: Middle stop (60%) of the aurora's vertical canvas gradient. Background only, never behind text on its own.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop (100%) of the aurora's vertical canvas gradient. Background only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default frosted fill for the glass primitive, cards and pager blocks. Always paired with backdrop-filter blur and saturate, the border-glass rim and shadow-glass.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised glass: hovered cards, pills, ghost buttons, the toast and the selected theme-switch segment.

tokens.name: nav-base
tokens.usage: Navbar pill fill under its two sage radials. Solidifies once the page scrolls past 12px: rgba(251, 250, 245, 0.84) light, rgba(17, 24, 37, 0.82) dark.

tokens.name: border-glass
tokens.usage: 1px rim highlight on every glass surface, pill, ghost button and the hero stage. It gives glass its edge; never remove it.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines: prose hr, the hero-corner circle outline and faint structural dividers. Green-tinted in light.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Faintest sage tint: inline code background and subtle fills. Light mesh-gradient colour 2.

tokens.name: sage-200
tokens.usage: Pale sage fill; the stylesheet does not reference it directly. In light it equals pill-bg (tags and the active nav item).

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Text selection background, the resting prose-link underline and light mesh-gradient colour 1. Selection pairs it with sage-700 text: 3.61:1 light, 4.84:1 dark (light misses 4.5:1).

tokens.name: sage-400
tokens.usage: Decorative marks: the 3px blockquote rule. Light mesh-gradient colour 3. Not for text in light (2.30:1 on bg).

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Primary accent and the focus ring (2px solid, 3px offset) on every interactive element: 3.06:1 on bg light, 7.30:1 dark. Prose list markers. Fills the hero theme switch in dark.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Accent text on the canvas: section and article headings, the eyebrow, the hero first name, the nav brand's first word. Fills the hero theme switch in light. On bg: 4.06:1 light (headings pass at 24px and up; the 0.78rem eyebrow misses 4.5:1, and so does the 1.15rem nav brand word at 3.5 to 4.4:1 on the nav glass), 9.06:1 dark. The hero first name sits on the mesh gradient, not bg: in light it falls to 2.0:1 over sage-400 and 2.7:1 over sage-300, under the 3:1 large-text floor; 5.8:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Strongest accent: links, card foot, backlink, tag text, active nav and theme-switch icons, inline code text. 5.88:1 on bg and 4.73:1 on pill-bg in light; 11.12:1 and 9.12:1 in dark.

tokens.name: pill-bg
tokens.usage: Shared fill for tags and the active nav item, so taxonomy and navigation read as one pill family. Equals sage-200 in light and sage-100 in dark: the dark pill fill stays at the deep sage tint on purpose. Carries sage-700 text.

tokens.name: sage-invert
tokens.usage: The opposite theme's sage-700, used only for the social chip and theme-cycle icon on hover. It is a deliberate flash, not a legible colour: 1.43:1 on bg light, 2.70:1 dark, below the 3:1 icon floor in both.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (11.2:1 light, 15.1:1 dark on bg). Off-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, card summaries, inactive nav links, pill text, blockquotes (blockquote paragraphs actually render in prose-ink). 5.75:1 light, 8.35:1 dark on bg; at least 6.1:1 on glass.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata: dates, reading time, pager direction labels, the hero-corner subtitle. Misses 4.5:1 at its small sizes everywhere except the dark canvas: 2.87:1 on bg and 3.07:1 on surface in light; 4.70:1 on bg (passes), 4.10:1 on surface and 3.57:1 on surface-2 (hovered cards) in dark. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: prose-ink
tokens.usage: Long-form paragraphs inside prose, slightly softer than ink. 9.39:1 light, 11.93:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background in both themes (One Dark; Hugo highlight style onedark). The one dark island in light mode.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code block text on code-bg (6.57:1).

tokens.name: aurora-tint-1
tokens.usage: Aurora's static radial wash from the top-right corner. Background only. Light runs the aurora stronger because sage reads faintly on warm beige; dark dials it back because the same green already stands out on navy.

tokens.name: aurora-tint-2
tokens.usage: Aurora's static radial wash from the bottom-left corner. Background only.

tokens.name: aurora-blob-1
tokens.usage: Centre of the top-left drifting aurora blob (blur 80px, drift1 26s). Background only.

tokens.name: aurora-blob-2
tokens.usage: Centre of the bottom-right drifting aurora blob (blur 80px, drift2 32s). Background only.

tokens.name: gradient-color-1
tokens.usage: Hero mesh gradient colour 1 (WebGL canvas uniform; the 38% stop of its static CSS fallback).

tokens.name: gradient-color-2
tokens.usage: Hero mesh gradient colour 2 (the 100% stop of the static fallback).

tokens.name: gradient-color-3
tokens.usage: Hero mesh gradient colour 3 (the 0% stop of the static fallback).

tokens.name: gradient-color-4
tokens.usage: Hero mesh gradient colour 4: the warm beige in light, the one muted sage inflection in dark (the 70% stop of the static fallback).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces, variable with optical sizing on (font-optical-sizing: auto). Track tight, lead tight, and let weight and the sage colour carry hierarchy rather than size alone.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: Base hero name (.hero h1, single-stage hero), centred. Fluid: clamp(2.9rem, 9.5vw, 6.8rem); 6.8rem is the cap. The live home uses the split hero, so hero-split-name is what renders there. First word in sage-600, second word italic 400 in ink.

styles.name: hero-split-name
styles.usage: Each stage of the split home hero. Fluid: clamp(2.7rem, 6.5vw, 4.2rem). Same colour split as hero.

styles.name: article-title
styles.usage: Article and About page h1, centred, in sage-600. Fluid: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 3.6rem).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section head h2 in sage-600. Fluid: clamp(1.9rem, 4.5vw, 3rem).

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.usage: h2 inside prose, in ink, 2.8rem above.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card h3 in ink; turns sage-700 on card hover.

styles.name: prose-h3
styles.usage: h3 inside prose, in ink, 2.2rem above.

styles.name: corner-title
styles.usage: Hero corner block title in ink. Fluid: clamp(1.05rem, 1.4vw, 1.3rem).

styles.name: blockquote
styles.sample: Software that stays small and runs for years.
styles.usage: Prose blockquote behind a 3px sage-400 rule. The rule sets ink-soft, but Markdown wraps quote text in a p, so .prose p (prose-ink) wins on the live site.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Navbar brand. The first word takes sage-600 at the same weight.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter, antialiased, 1.6 leading. Weight 450 is part of the scale. Keep body lines to about 65 characters: prose caps at 44rem, leads and heads at 60ch.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Notes on building software, design decisions, and whatever I'm learning this week.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a heading, in ink-soft, max-width 60ch. Fluid: clamp(1.02rem, 1.6vw, 1.18rem).

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: I like software that stays small and runs for years without paging anyone.
styles.usage: Long-form body inside prose, in prose-ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Engineer and builder. I design, ship, and maintain software, and write about it.
styles.usage: Base body text in ink.

styles.name: card-summary
styles.sample: A short summary of the post in one or two lines.
styles.usage: Card summary paragraph in ink-soft.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and toast labels.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Navbar menu links in ink-soft; the active link is weight 500 in sage-700 on pill-bg.

styles.name: link-strong
styles.usage: Card foot and backlink, in sage-700.

styles.name: article-meta
styles.usage: Article meta row (date, reading time) in ink-faint.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Pill text in ink-soft: the blog list page counter.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card meta and hero-corner subtitle in ink-faint.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in sage-600. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tag pill text, sage-700 on pill-bg.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Code blocks: code-ink on code-bg.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside prose: sage-700 on sage-100, 0.4rem radius. Relative to the surrounding text.

spacing.note: Spacing is fluid and mostly written as clamp() in components; the only spacing custom property is the container width.

tokens.name: maxw
tokens.usage: Container max width (.wrap), centred, with padding-inline clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem).

radius.note: Large, soft radii. Every interactive chip, button, nav and tag is fully pill-rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks and other small panels.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The glass primitive and pager blocks; prose images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero stage and the hero corner's outer corner. Drops to 1.75rem at 620px and below.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, buttons, the navbar, nav links, the theme switch and the toast. Circles (social chips, the corner circle) use 50% instead.

shadow.note: Shadows are tinted to the canvas hue: warm green in light, black in dark. Never a flat grey drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass: the glass primitive, cards, the hero stage, code blocks and prose images. The inset top line is the rim catching light.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Elevated glass: hovered cards and pager blocks, the stuck navbar, the toast.
